controlled_change: Only residency off/core. Five alternating fresh-process pairs, fixed reference native build and mixed artifact, CLOCK, 12GiB, 1848 slots, 72-token prompt and 128-token retained append, 33 outputs per request. No diagnostics or Metal validation. Earlier evidence and incomplete unpaired control not pooled.
correctness: 178 Python tests passed. Native build unchanged from earlier 56 tests and 45682 assertions with Metal validation. All 20 requests matched control output IDs and expected reuse; memory and core-only enrollment validated. No new independent model or coding-quality evaluation.
decision_origin: authored interpretation; original report statuses retained
expected_effect: At least 1 percent lower geometric-mean conversation time, primary upper 95 percent interval below no improvement, and each request metric upper bound at most 1.03. These gates were frozen before five new pairs.
hypothesis: Core residency provides repeatable lower complete-conversation latency beyond the two-pair screen.
limitations: Five new pairs only; prior diagnostic/screen and incomplete unpaired control are not pooled.
Model-based Student-t intervals assume independent approximately normal pair log-ratios. Host drift and large stalls challenge those assumptions; intervals are marginal, not simultaneous.
The fixed primary gate failed. Median improvement alone cannot promote the configuration. All observed slow runs remain included.
Normal memory and phase counters do not locate every wait. GPU duration, CPU waiting, concurrent I/O and coordinator waiting overlap and are not additive.
System swap increased during the run; system counters include other processes. No live per-phase host power/thermal/GPU-contention trace was captured.
Short 72-token initial prompt and 128-token append to 104 retained computed tokens; no 2K/4K/7K or sustained-session qualification.
Output parity is not new full-logit/state proof or independent coding-quality evaluation. Native build, weights and arithmetic are unchanged.
outcome: Complete five-pair gate failed. Conversation ratios 0.983971, 0.981841, 0.783258, 1.004179, 1.473007; geometric mean 1.022796 with model-based 95 percent interval 0.770713 to 1.357329. Core won three pairs but final core took 94.19 seconds versus 63.94 off. Final core GPU/coordinator durations grew with few decompressions and lower read-service sums. Initial failed admission was retained; one metadata retry in the completed 717.54-second run. System swap changed during capture.
smallest_experiment: Add a small resident GPU operation before and after a normal conversation, outside measured request time, with available host power/thermal observations and explicit missing data. Hold residency fixed and compare the timing reference with existing GPU/read/memory counters to investigate execution-speed variation before further long qualification.
